facts: The excavation identifies a 106.60 m cavea diameter and a half-round orchestra with preserved paving. The timber stage platform survives as foundations.
The modern canopy is set at about the original theater's 25 m height above the archaeological level. A visit follows the lower gallery and the former stage.

record: Carmen Aguarod Otal, museum project description
facts: Restoration uses 21 columns under a spatial framework of tubular rods and spherical joints with translucent polycarbonate sheets. Modern walkways follow the levels of the ancient circulation where possible.

record: Municipal archaeological study of the theater
facts: The stage and north portico sit on the northern side of the semicircular seating. A central passage and two lateral passages connected the orchestra to the exterior.
